name: 訪問リストと都市と分類から探す保存見出し
prompt:
Create one clean, reusable Japanese saved-places header for a mobile app, isolated on a pure-white canvas in a wide horizontal composition.

Reference priority:
1) The first image is a lossless crop of the original screen. It controls the row structure, exact icon geometry, control outlines, spacing, and selected-tab indicator shape.
2) The second image is the Japanese adaptation preview. Use it for the exact Japanese wording and Lighthouse green. Do not copy its simplified icons when they differ from the original.

Rebuild only the header:
- First row: bold title “保存した場所” on the left. On the right, a soft light-neutral pill button labeled “地図” with the original folded-map outline and location pin glyph.
- Second row: four tabs in this order: “訪問済み”, “行きたい”, “おすすめ”, “コレクション”. “訪問済み” is selected. Preserve the original filled-circle checkmark before its label and a short underline beneath the selected tab. Adapt the active check circle, label, and underline to Lighthouse green #2D8F5E. The other tab labels are calm slate #6E6E6E.
- A thin neutral divider separates the tabs from the tools row.
- Third row: a circular outlined sort control with the original stacked up/down chevrons; an outlined “都市” dropdown pill; an outlined “分類” dropdown pill; then two circular outlined controls aligned to the right: a magnifying-glass search icon and the original share icon, an upward arrow rising from an open-top square.

Keep each original icon’s recognizable stroke and optical weight. Use crisp thin neutral-gray outlines, near-black #1D1D1D for active text and icons, slate #6E6E6E for inactive text, and green only for the active tab. Use Meiryo-style Japanese sans-serif: title Bold20/28; tabs and controls Regular14/20, with the selected tab slightly stronger. Give the three rows compact but distinct vertical spacing, align controls on consistent centers, and let the tab underline track the selected tab label plus checkmark. Preserve the clean white native feel.

Do not add a phone status bar, list rows, map artwork, bottom navigation, extra actions, gradients, decorative panels, invented icons, or English text. Keep all Japanese glyphs complete, exact, and readable; keep the search and share buttons distinct.
reviewNotes: エージェント確認済み候補。日本語見出しと4タブを確認。元の地図ピン、チェック、上下ソート、検索、上向き共有アイコンを保持。選択色は緑。オーナー承認・実装は未確認。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
